title: 9 Best Herbal Teas For Bloating
description: Silybum marianum teas, also known as milk thistle tea, have been traditionally used to treat the bloating ailment due to their anti-inflammatory and carminative properties. The herbal preparation helps to treat bloating by reducing inflammation in the digestive tract, alleviating discomfort and promoting the movement of gas through the digestive system.
